about: The two-hand deal from pose 2.3, laid by dealer3d/tools/deal-film.ts (dealer3d/src/two-hand.ts). A model in a real dealer's tempo: the moments of each card and where the hands change are read off a film of a real dealer (dealer3d/src/real-deal.ts), the hands' shapes and the start are the pose film's, everything between is drawn. Same frame and fields as the read deals; card.id says which card is in play, laid lists the cards that lie and from which frame, beats the moments of every card in frames.
